document:0:47:0.text:
A thick, marshy scent greets you; this elixir can transcend limits and revert things to their original form.

Typically made from <style="highlight">ghostfly wings</style>, <style="highlight">elderwood strands</style>, and <style="highlight">whisperblooms</style>. Remember, it should not be used on living creatures.
document:0:47:0.source_cn:
厚重的沼泽气息扑面而来，这种药水能跨越界限，让事物还原到最初的状态。
一般由<style="highlight">亡蝶羽翼</style>，<style="highlight">巨树灵须</style>，<style="highlight">忍紫花</style>炼制而成。切记，不可对生物使用。
